# Solve Equations[¶](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/index.html#solve-equations)

The Python package SymPy can symbolically solve equations, differential equations, linear equations, nonlinear equations, matrix problems, inequalities, Diophantine equations, and evaluate integrals. SymPy can also solve numerically.

The [Solving Guidance](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solving-guidance.html) page provides recommendations applicable to many types of solving tasks.

Learn how to use SymPy computer algebra system to:

Description

Example

Solution

[Solve an equation algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-equation-algebraically.html)

[Solve a system of equations algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-system-of-equations-algebraically.html)

[Solve one or a system of equations numerically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-numerically.html)

[Solve an ordinary differential equation algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-ode.html)

[Solve ordinary and partial differential equations by Laplace transform](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-de-laplace.html)

[Find the roots of a polynomial algebraically or numerically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/find-roots-polynomial.html)

[Solve a matrix equation algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-matrix-equation.html)

[Reduce one or a system of inequalities for a single variable algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/reduce-inequalities-algebraically.html)

[Solve a Diophantine equation algebraically](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/guides/solving/solve-diophantine-equation.html)

Notes:

- SymPy has a function called [`solve()`](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/solvers/solvers.html#sympy.solvers.solvers.solve) which is designed to find the solutions of an equation or system of equations, or the roots of a function. SymPy [`solve()`](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/solvers/solvers.html#sympy.solvers.solvers.solve) may or may not be what you need for a particular problem, so we recommend you use the links on this page to learn how to “solve” your problem.
- While a common, colloquial expression is, for example, “[solve an integral](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/integrals/integrals.html),” in SymPy’s terminology it would be “[evaluate an integral](https://docs.sympy.org/dev/modules/integrals/integrals.html).” This page does not provide guidance for such tasks. Please search the documentation for the type of expression you want to evaluate.
